scope: Read-only deployment logs and bounded Supabase logs/health inspection; no private response bodies, credentials or raw request headers retained.

postgres.statementShape: All four logged statements select the public games card columns plus description with review_count >= $1, score >= $2, cover_image IS NOT NULL and cover_image <> $3, ordered trending DESC NULLS LAST, verdict_score DESC NULLS LAST, release_date DESC, id ASC, LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5, then PostgREST JSON aggregation.
postgres.notAttributedTo: No Explore RPC or list membership SQL was present in these four PostgreSQL cancellations. Application list deadlines are separate observations.

healthObservation.limits: A later point-in-time observation does not exclude earlier transient contention or establish the cause of network resets.

decision: Release reliability remains open pending separately approved index and actual cold/warm/concurrent HTTP verification; rendered cached success is insufficient.
